name: Octree-based Divide and Conquer Transformation
definition: A method to reduce computation burden in forward viewing by exploiting spatial coherency in voxel space. It represents the 3D volume as an octree, grouping neighboring voxels with the same or similar values (up to a threshold) into uniform cubic subvolumes, which are transformed and rendered as a single unit.
summary: Octree-based Divide and Conquer Transformation is an object-space optimization that groups coherent voxels into uniform sub-volumes for efficient, hierarchical rendering.
